name: AI Agent MVP
summary: An AI agent that monitors Facebook Messenger conversations, qualifies prospects, schedules appointments in Urbana, and reports conversion metrics in real time.
functions: Responds to messages, classifies customer intent, checks appointment availability, creates conflict-free bookings, and tracks interactions through an analytics dashboard.
problem: Prospects messaging outside business hours were not receiving timely responses, causing missed opportunities and leaving the company without reliable conversion or agent-performance data.
solution: I connected an NLP-based conversational flow to the Facebook Messenger API and Urbana, adding automated 24/7 scheduling and a live dashboard for interactions, sales-funnel metrics, and conversation insights.

demo.title: Private integration
demo.description: The live agent is connected to private Messenger conversations, prospect data, analytics, and the Urbana scheduling system, so public access is unavailable.
